item.title: Reminder: Use Your Summer 2026 Block Plan Meal Swipes
item.description: Attention Summer 2026 Block Plan users. This is a friendly reminder to use all of your Summer 2026 meal plan swipes before the end of the day on Friday, August 14. Any unused meal swipes remaining after August 14 will expire and cannot be carried over or refunded.
item.author: Students

item.title: Electrochemistry Workshop for RPI Community – Aug 11-12, 2026 (Registration Required)
item.description: Date: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 9:00 AM - Wed , August 12, 2026 5:00 PM - The workshop is free to attend and will include both lecture and lab. Open to faculty, postdocs, graduate students and undergrads. Please complete registration before Mon, Aug 3. Attendance will be capped at 24-30 participants.
item.author: Community

item.title: Accepting parcels/mail for 2026 fall semester incoming students.
item.description: The Student Mail Center will accept and hold packages for on-campus residents. Once processed, the student will receive an email with pickup instructions at a parcel locker or the service counter. Additional address and shipping information can be found on the RPI Student Mail Center’s website.
item.author: Community

item.title: Accepting parcels/mail for 2026 fall semester incoming students.
item.description: The Student Mail Center will begin accepting packages and mail for on-campus residents beginning August 1, 2026. Once processed, the student will receive an email indicating which parcel locker the package is placed in. Addressing instructions and a list of on-campus residences can be found on the RPI Student Mail Center’s website.
item.author: Community

item.title: Help Us Enhance RPI MAX – We Want to Hear From You!
item.description:
Your feedback is important as we continue to enhance RPI MAX. If you have suggestions or feedback about the FY26 Staff Performance Review Cycle, please take a few minutes to complete the RPI MAX Feedback Form. Your input will help inform future enhancements to the RPI MAX experience.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
item.author: Faculty and Staff
